usage: arb-engine maker [-h] [--sport {nfl,tennis,ncaaf,nba,nhl,mlb}] [--venues VENUES]
                        [--contracts CONTRACTS] [--target-margin TARGET_MARGIN] [--books]
                        [--candidate-margin CANDIDATE_MARGIN] [--gold]
                        [--max-quote-age MAX_QUOTE_AGE] [--markets MARKETS]
                        [--mode {paper,demo,live}] [--confirm] [--size SIZE]
                        [--min-margin MIN_MARGIN] [--max-orders MAX_ORDERS]
                        [--max-notional MAX_NOTIONAL] [--max-per-event MAX_PER_EVENT]
                        [--deep-queue] [--interval INTERVAL] [--rescan RESCAN]
                        [--duration DURATION] [--iterations ITERATIONS] [--journal JOURNAL]
                        [--state STATE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sport {nfl,tennis,ncaaf,nba,nhl,mlb}
  --venues VENUES
  --contracts CONTRACTS
                        reference size for fee rounding
  --target-margin TARGET_MARGIN
                        required locked-in margin per $1 payout for max-buy prices
  --books               second pass: fetch real order books for candidate events (margin above
                        --candidate-margin) and re-size
  --candidate-margin CANDIDATE_MARGIN
                        events at or above this top-of-book margin get real depth in the --books
                        pass
  --gold                price Robinhood commission at the Gold rate
  --max-quote-age MAX_QUOTE_AGE
                        seconds; snapshots older than this are excluded from arb legs
  --markets MARKETS     comma list of market types to include
  --mode {paper,demo,live}
                        paper = simulated fills from live prices (default); demo = real orders on
                        Kalshi demo; live = prod (needs --confirm + ARB_LIVE_TRADING=1)
  --confirm             required for demo/live order placement
  --size SIZE           contracts per resting order
  --min-margin MIN_MARGIN
                        required margin per $1 if filled and hedged at the current ask
  --max-orders MAX_ORDERS
  --max-notional MAX_NOTIONAL
                        max dollars resting across all orders
  --max-per-event MAX_PER_EVENT
  --deep-queue          also rest below the current best bid (default: only at/above it)
  --interval INTERVAL   seconds between quote refreshes
  --rescan RESCAN       seconds between full cross-venue scans
  --duration DURATION   seconds to run
  --iterations ITERATIONS
                        stop after N loops (testing)
  --journal JOURNAL
  --state STATE         write watches/orders/fills JSON here on exit
